messages:
Lina (People Ops): Drafting a short 'preboard + first-week + 30/60/90' cheat sheet specifically for new managers. Want it micro and copy-pasteable. Thoughts?

Diego (Hiring Manager): +1. Can we include a small 'preboard to-dos' that hires can complete before Day 1? Makes Day 0 smoother.

Aria (Eng Manager): Add oncall shadow scheduling, staging RBAC by default, prod access via request. Also note model teams should request Redwood Dedicated quota early.

Lina (People Ops): Great. Quick draft below. Intentionally brief.

Lina (People Ops): PREBOARD (before Day 1)
- [ ] Complete HR forms + benefits enrollment link
- [ ] Verify Google account activation and MFA
- [ ] Confirm preferred buddy and timezone for meetings
- [ ] Fill short stakeholder form (who to meet first: infra, security, product, recruiting)

Lina (People Ops): DAY 1 MICRO AGENDA
- 09:00 intro with People Ops (paperwork recap, benefits Qs)
- 09:30 tech access check (Slack, GitHub, Redwood Console viewer)
- 10:00 quick team hello (10m) + schedule 1:1s with directs
- 11:00 security intro (SSO/KMS owner intro)
- 13:00 lunch/meet buddy
- 15:00 calendar setup: block focus time + office hours

Lina (People Ops): FIRST WEEK (musts)
- Meet each direct report (30m) using 30/60/90 prompts
- Share 1-slide stakeholder map by Day 5
- Confirm CI/CD and deploy-bot access; request staging perms if missing
- If applicable: schedule oncall shadow within 10 days
- Complete 7-day pulse: three Qs (missing accounts, role clarity, blockers)

Lina (People Ops): 2-WEEK GUIDELINES
- Interviews: max 2/day for first 14 days
- Avoid >4 hours meetings/day; protect 1h focus block daily
- Staging RBAC by default; prod via request + security review

Lina (People Ops): 30/60/90 (leadership prompts)
- 30d: meet skip-levels, map org & priorities, unblock top 2 issues, complete at least 1 interview loop
- 60d: lead one postmortem or planning session, propose a process improvement, progress hiring pipeline
- 90d: present Q+1 plan, define 2 measurable KPIs, onboard improvements for ICs

Sam (Onboarding): We'll link this into the offer packet and enable the one-week pulse in the HR system. OnboardBot will copy the template to /docs/onboarding/manager-preboard.md

Diego (Hiring Manager): Add hiring expectation: candidate scorecards within 48h and debrief within 72h. Also recommend sending a short intro email to the team the day before start.

Aria (Eng Manager): Ops note: model teams should request Redwood Dedicated/GPU quota ASAP. Add link to the model catalog in the one-pager.

Lina (People Ops): Will add quick links and the hiring timing note. Thanks all 44d I'll finalize the one-pager and attach to offer flows tonight. If no more edits, I'll close this thread.
